The '''1937 Upper Iowa Peacocks football team''' was an [[American football]] team that represented [[Upper Iowa University]] as a member of the [[American Rivers Conference|Iowa Conference]] during the [[1937 college football season]]. In their 29th season under head coach [[John "Doc" Dorman]], the Peacocks compiled a 6–0 record, shared the Iowa Conference championship with {{cfb link|year=1937|team=St. Ambrose Bees|title=St. Ambrose}}, and outscored opponents by a total of 122 to 26.<ref>{{cite web |title=1937 - Upper Iowa |publisher=College Football Data Warehouse |accessdate=June 3, 2022 |url=http://www.cfbdatawarehouse.com/data/incomplete_data/game_by_game_current.php?teamid=3302&year=1937 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150919053748/http://www.cfbdatawarehouse.com/data/incomplete_data/game_by_game_current.php?teamid=3302&year=1937 |archive-date=19 September 2015 |url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Celebration Held at Gym Tuesday: Dr. and Mrs. Dorman and the Football Squad Honored at Celebration Tuesday|newspaper=Fayette County Leader|date=November 25, 1937|page=1|url=https://www.newspapers.com/clip/103109599/celebration-held-at-gym-tuesday-dr/|via=[[Newspapers.com]]}}</ref>

The team played its home games on Dorman Field in [[Fayette, Iowa]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Fayette on Volga River Is Home of Upper Iowa University|newspaper=The Courier|date=October 3, 1937|page=30|url=https://www.newspapers.com/clip/103128517/fayette-on-volga-river-is-home-of-upper/|via=[[Newspapers.com]]}}</ref>
